thread:
alex: Deploying config-only change now — routing policy tweak for sidecar + batching window. canary at 5% for 15m. change window 12:00-13:00 PT.

deploy-bot: starting canary job id c-20260321-01 · targets: service=sidecar, env=prod-canary · config: routing.weight=0.05, batch.max_tokens=2048, timeout.ms=60000

meera: quick Q — are we pinning model version for the canary or letting smart-routing pick fallback variants?

alex: pinning to model v2.4.1 for this because we want stable perf profile. fallback still allowed to v2.3.9 only on capacity errors.

juan: noted. will watch kvcache hit rate and p95 decode. threshold: p95 > 300ms or error_rate > 0.5% => abort.

sam-sre: adding health hooks: prometheus.alert: sidecar_p95_latency_ms{job="sidecar"} > 300 for 3m AND sidecar_error_rate > 0.5%

olivia: put the release note blurb in the product channel? small consumer-visible routing tweak but no feature changes. I'll draft.

meera: if kvcache pressure rises, do we prefer increasing batch window or roll back? My vote: roll back first, then tune batch.max_tokens.

alex: agreed. rollback plan: immediate unpin + revert routing.weight to previous config (0.02) and disable batching tweak. rollback command: ``/deploy config revert c-20260321-01 --reason=canary-failure``

deploy-bot: canary job c-20260321-01: 5% live, started 12:05 PT. health checks enabled. will report at 12:20 PT or on alert.

juan: seeing a few elevated latencies in canary shard a (p95 ~ 290ms) — still under threshold but trending up.

sam-sre: slight uptick in kvcache miss rate from 6% -> 12% on canary pods. watching memory.

alex: hold on ramp. keep at 5% for another 15m and let caching warm. do not roll forward to 20% yet.

meera: noted. updating release notes: "config-only: routing weight adjusted for sidecar (canary), batching max_tokens increased to 2048; pinned to model v2.4.1. Monitoring p95 latency and error rate."
